apps.name: SideInstaller
apps.subtitle: An an app that installs Sidestore on iOS 27, fully on-device
apps.localizedDescription: Install SideStore and LiveContainer directly on your iPhone. No PC required.
apps.versionDescription:
# Added

- Custom .ipas now get automatically signed with Extended Memory Limit
- Downloads now get paused instead of cancelled, so users can resume at anytime
- Sound effects, which can be disabled with silent mode or on the app’s settings

# Fixed

- Bug reports now attach the full log to GitHub
- Fixed GitHub’s “Whoops, something went wrong!” when reporting an error
- When the device refuses the connection, SideInstaller asks which port it advertises for remote pairing and tries that one before giving up (#56, #100).

# Changed

- Madeira is now fetched from the official repo. It was fetched from a fork of mine before since it was needed for it to be compatible, but since it has been merged the source is now the main repo.
- Key bytes take one line in the log, not one line per byte. Private keys stay redacted.
